contract: Tools jobs report through task_started and task_finished, emitted by TaskManager to every socket that authenticated and never to anonymous ones (TaskManager.js:22-37, SocketAuthority.js:57-65). Each payload is the Task.toJSON() projection (Task.js:54-74): id, action (embed-metadata or encode-m4b), the job's data with libraryItemId and options, title 'Embedding Metadata'/'Encoding M4b' with their translation keys, description with the media title as the only substitution, error/errorKey/errorSubs null until terminal, showSuccess false, isFailed/isFinished false at start, startedAt a millisecond number, finishedAt null on task_started and >= startedAt on task_finished. Failures and user cancellation set isFailed true with the stage's error key (MessageTaskTargetDirectoryNotWritable, MessageTaskAudioFileNotWritable, MessageTaskFailedToEmbedMetadataInFile, MessageTaskFailedToMergeAudioFiles, MessageTaskCanceledByUser).

invariants.contract: task_started and task_finished of tools jobs carry the full Task.toJSON() projection to every authenticated socket (anonymous sockets receive neither), a rejected admission produces neither, each job's finish closes the task it started, a repeated job gets a fresh id with startedAt at or after the predecessor's finishedAt, a forced embed records forceEmbedChapters and its chapters, and failures or user cancellation set isFailed true with error/errorKey (Task.js:99-111).
